title_en: The Formula That Came on Day Twelve
note_en: In A 比 B + adjective + 多了, the 多了 after the adjective doesn't mean something has happened; it strengthens the comparison: "much …." In the text: 运费也比那时候便宜多了 "shipping is much cheaper than back then"; 比从海外慢慢漂洋过海快多了 "much faster than slowly crossing the ocean." Compare 便宜了 "it got cheaper" with 便宜多了 "it's much cheaper."
